name: Predictive Buffer
description: Merged & improved predictive input buffer (from Click Before Frames + Afterflow). Delays early clicks/releases with ghost prediction. Full Android support + clean mobile UI. Not legit.

practice-only.name: Practice mode only
practice-only.description: Only buffer inputs while in Practice Mode. Recommended for safety.

smart-prediction.name: Smart prediction (orbs/pads/portals)
smart-prediction.description: Ghost can use orbs, pads, gravity & speed portals. Turn off if you see glitches.

sim-budget-ms.name: Prediction time budget (ms)
sim-budget-ms.description: Max time spent predicting per click. Higher = better long saves, may hitch on dense levels. Mobile: try 4-8.

auto-budget.name: Auto time budget
auto-budget.description: Automatically adjust budget based on current FPS / performance.

performance-mode.name: Performance mode
performance-mode.description: Reduce prediction quality for smoother gameplay on weak devices.

tps.name: Physics TPS
tps.description: Game physics ticks per second. 240 is legit. Other values are not.

check-updates.name: Check for updates on start
check-updates.description: Look for newer versions on GitHub when the game starts.

panel-auto-hide.name: Auto-hide panel while playing
panel-auto-hide.description: Hide the console/stage panel during active gameplay so it doesn't block the screen. Show it when paused or when you toggle it.

panel-opacity.name: Panel opacity
panel-opacity.description: Transparency of the in-game panel (0.3 = very transparent, 1.0 = solid).

panel-scale.name: Panel scale (mobile)
panel-scale.description: Size of the panel. Increase on large phones if text is hard to read.

show-path.name: Show path view on level start
show-path.description: Automatically enable path visualization when entering a level.

menu-theme.name: Menu theme
menu-theme.description: Color theme of the Buffer menu.

custom-ticks.name: Custom stage: max delay (ticks)
custom-ticks.description: Max delay for CUSTOM stage (all modes except wave). 4 ticks ≈ 1 frame @ 60fps.

custom-wave-ticks.name: Custom stage: max wave delay (ticks)
custom-wave-ticks.description: Max delay for CUSTOM stage while in wave.

ground-horizon.name: Cube / ball / spider lookahead (ticks)
ground-horizon.description: How far ahead prediction looks for cube, ball, spider. Higher catches later hits but costs more CPU.

wave-horizon.name: Wave lookahead (ticks)
wave-horizon.description: How far ahead wave prediction looks (mini wave uses a bit less).

ship-max-delay.name: Ship: max delay (ticks)
ship-max-delay.description: Maximum delay allowed for ship inputs.

orb-assume-hit.name: Orbs: assume you click them
orb-assume-hit.description: Ghost clicks every orb it touches (calculation mode). Very useful on orb-heavy levels.

orb-try-both.name: Orbs: also try the other choice
orb-try-both.description: When an orb has two possible outcomes, test both.

orb-align.name: Orb alignment
orb-align.description: Fine-tune click timing inside orbs for better survival.

orb-align-ticks.name: Orb alignment: max delay (ticks)
orb-align-ticks.description: Maximum extra delay used for orb alignment.

orb-align-ground.name: Orb alignment: also from ground
orb-align-ground.description: Also consider alignment when jumping from ground into orbs.

orb-timing.name: Orb timing (precise)
orb-timing.description: Try multiple timings inside the orb window and pick the safest middle.

dash-auto-release.name: Dash orb auto-release
dash-auto-release.description: Automatically release after using dash orbs when safe.

wave-auto-release.name: Wave auto-release
wave-auto-release.description: Automatically release in wave when holding would crash.

auto-release-window.name: Auto-release window (ticks)
auto-release-window.description: How many ticks before a predicted crash the auto-release can fire.

wave-safety-margin.name: Wave: safety margin
wave-safety-margin.description: Add a small safety margin to wave predictions.

wave-v46.name: Wave: old v4.6 logic
wave-v46.description: Use older wave prediction logic (sometimes better on certain levels).

robot-smart.name: Robot: smart jumps
robot-smart.description: Smarter hold timing for robot mode.

robot-auto-release.name: Robot auto-release
robot-auto-release.description: Auto-release robot hold when continuing would crash.

ship-spam-gap.name: Ship: spam gap (ticks)
ship-spam-gap.description: Minimum gap between ship inputs considered spam.

full-ghost-state.name: Full ghost state
full-ghost-state.description: Copy more player state into the ghost (more accurate, slightly heavier).

predict-through-portals.name: Predict through portals
predict-through-portals.description: Continue prediction after mode/size/dual portals instead of stopping.

predict-moving-objects.name: Predict moving objects (experimental)
predict-moving-objects.description: Attempt to account for moving platforms/hazards. Can be unstable.

avoid-moving-objects.name: Don't buffer near moving objects
avoid-moving-objects.description: Skip buffering when close to moving objects to avoid bad predictions.

level-memory.name: Level memory (learn from runs)
level-memory.description: Remember successful delays on this level and reuse them.

robust-saves.name: Robust saves
robust-saves.description: Stricter checks before accepting a delayed input as safe.

low-latency.name: Low latency mode
low-latency.description: Prefer faster response over maximum delay. Good for high-refresh or fast gameplay.

cbf-sync.name: Click Between Frames sync
cbf-sync.description: Better sync with mid-frame click detection.

ignore-touching-hazards.name: Ignore hazards you're already touching
ignore-touching-hazards.description: Don't treat already-touching hazards as new crashes.

cube-late-crash.name: Cube: ignore crashes after (ticks)
cube-late-crash.description: Ignore predicted crashes that happen very late after the input.

more-time-death-spots.name: More time at death spots
more-time-death-spots.description: Spend extra prediction time near places you keep dying.

auto-click.name: Auto-click (practice only)
auto-click.description: In practice mode, automatically click when doing nothing would crash and a click is fully safe.

auto-release-normal-runs.name: Auto-release in normal runs
auto-release-normal-runs.description: Allow auto-release features even outside practice mode.

wave-spam-gap.name: Wave spam: max gap (ticks)
wave-spam-gap.description: Max gap between wave inputs to count as spam.

wave-spam-streak.name: Spam: inputs in a row
wave-spam-streak.description: How many rapid inputs in a row count as spam.

debug-console.name: Windows debug console
debug-console.description: Open a separate Windows console with live log (Windows only). Needs restart.

drift-check.name: Drift check (debug)
drift-check.description: Extra validation that ghost state matches real player.

death-log.name: Death log (debug)
death-log.description: Log details when the ghost dies.

explain-inputs.name: Explain every input (debug)
explain-inputs.description: Verbose logging of why each input was delayed or not.

training-mode.name: Training mode (hints only)
training-mode.description: Show hints without actually buffering inputs.

death-heatmap.name: Death heatmap
death-heatmap.description: Visualize places where you/ghost die frequently.

save-ding.name: Ding on successful save
save-ding.description: Play a short sound when an early click is successfully delayed.

per-level-settings.name: Per-level settings
per-level-settings.description: Remember some settings per level ID.

bind-menu.name: Open Buffer menu
bind-menu.description: Open the main Buffer menu (also available from Pause).

bind-console.name: Show / hide console panel
bind-console.description: Toggle the in-game stage + log panel.

bind-path.name: Toggle path view
bind-path.description: Show / hide the predicted path visualization.

bind-export.name: Copy console log
bind-export.description: Copy the current console log to clipboard.

bind-forget.name: Forget this level
bind-forget.description: Clear learned memory for the current level.
